newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian prosecutor probes ARS diamond firm - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russian prosecutor probes ARS diamond firm - agency.

text.p: Russia's prosecutor general's office has launched an investigation into diamond producer Almazy Rossii-Sakha, or ARS, over alleged currency violations and tax evasion, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday.

Talks between ARS, which is Russia's sole diamond producer and authorised exporter, and South Africa's De Beers over a diamond export deal produced a framework agreement last month which is awaiting government approval.

Interfax quoted Finance Minister Alexander Livshits as saying that a special government commission set up to boost tax revenues had decided after a closed meeting to "verify" ARS's relationship to De Beers.
It quoted him as saying that ARS could face fines for hard currency violations alone of $379 million.
No comment was immediately available from ARS, whose top managers were six time zones away in the Yakutian town of Mirny.

Interfax quoted the prosecutor general's office as saying that an investigation had been launched on the basis of materials prepared by tax officials from both the State Tax Inspectorate and the special tax commission.
The agency said that ARS owed 46 billion roubles in tax arrears and that the company received nearly $87 million from what it said were illegal sales of diamonds.
